title: Planning asks the design choices of an item that adds a push path before the start gate
goal: Planning a sprint item whose goal adds a command that pushes or changes push configuration (a target ref, a value the user may already have set, a staleness stamp and its bounds) records each choice the goal leaves open as a blocking gate before the start gate, so a worker does not stop on it mid-work (SP-mguax5m3 close: ST-f4fwtc4v g1, ST-tmvkydpf g1 and ST-7zojvqwc g1 were raised by workers as blocking push or agents-rule gates and waited for the orchestrator)

run: import sys; s = open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md').read(); i = s.find('## plan'); j = s.find('## start'); sys.exit(0 if 'adds a push path' in s[i:j] else 1)
